scope: GRT-only A/B from unchanged reviewed HCPL v1b 4_cts; no production route or adoption
findings: 114.48um square without macros; no macro walls/halos required; pins distributed on all four faces, strongest bus at north face.
Continuous parallel PG stripes; density predominantly green with isolated warm bins rather than a corridor hotspot.
Worst prior FF path is short internal register chain with clock skew, not a long relay-less wire. Slot span well below405um.
No geometry, pins, clock or RTL changes in experiment; same exact CTS checkpoint in both arms.
Compare native TT setup and FF hold in their own vclk frames; mixed FF-frame TT optimizer reports do not qualify.
